Rohan — thanks for coordinating. Uploaded my scorecard to GH (ran through the questions there). Top-line: Hire (with conditions).

Notes:
- Technical: 4/5. Strong ML fundamentals and practical tradeoffs. Did well on distributed training Qs but weaker on systems-level optimization (quantization experience limited).
- Design: 3.5/5. Good product sense; suggested sensible rollout plan for model updates.
- Collaboration & ownership: 5/5. Clear examples of driving cross-functional projects and rallying engineers + PMs.

Concerns: needs a little ramp on low-level CUDA/kernel work if we want them to own inference optimizations quickly. Recommend a 6–8 week learning plan and pairing with infra eng for first quarter.

Attached: my short bullet notes in GH comments.

Laura
Laura Bennett | Engineering Manager — ML Platforms

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-interview feedback: Senior ML Engineer (onsite) - Asha Rao

Thanks — uploaded my scorecard. My recommendation: Hold.

Summary:
- Technical depth: 3/5. Reasonable across modeling questions but struggled to explain trade-offs for inference latency at scale. When pushed on KV cache invalidation and memory footprint, responses were fuzzy.
- Ownership: 4/5. Good examples of team communication; would be a solid IC but may not be ready for owning end-to-end production inference now.
- Cultural fit: 5/5. Great collaborator.

Blockers: I don't think we'd get full infra ownership in first 3 months without extra ramp time — which is OK, but that should be part of leveling/comp plan. If everyone else is strongly +, I can be convinced, but I don't recommend immediate offer without a technical deep dive focused on systems/inference.

Monica
Monica Patel | Staff ML Engineer, Inference Runtime

- Monica: Hold (requests systems deep-dive)
- Neha: (no response yet)

2) If Neha is not green, schedule a 60m system-design deep-dive with Monica + an infra engineer next week and re-evaluate.

Can I get a final quick vote from Neha? Also, Monica — are you available Tue or Wed next week to run the systems deep-dive (if needed)? I can set up the calendar.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-interview feedback: Senior ML Engineer (onsite) - Asha Rao

Apologies for the delay — was heads-down in planning. Uploaded my scorecard and my vote: Hire.

Quick rationale:
- Tech: 4/5. While not a deep systems engineer today, Asha shows fast learning and has prior experience migrating models into production with monitoring and rollback strategies that map well to our needs.
- Risk mitigation: Agree with Laura on a 6-week pairing plan and a conditional 45–60m tech follow-up focusing on latency trade-offs.

Given 2x Hire and 1x Hold, I'm comfortable moving to HCM + comp. Recommend we make the offer contingent on passing the short systems follow-up (documented in GH). If Monica still wants the deep-dive first, happy to join and make it part of the offer condition.

Neha Kapoor | Director, Talent Acquisition
